name: Cipérez (Spain)
description: Square red flag with four white crosses patty in saltire around the crowned municipal arms of Cipérez at the centre (a bridge and fleurs-de-lis on white and blue).
history: The municipal flag is square, of proportions 1:1, formed of a red cloth with four silver crosses patty in saltire and the arms of Cipérez at the centre.

features.role: four crosses patty in saltire around the arms
Cipérez arms — bridge and fleurs-de-lis on white and blue, with the letters S.S.
